# OP Auto Clicker

> OP Auto Clicker is a free, open-source auto-clicking program for Windows.
> It supports up to 100+ clicks per second, custom intervals from 1ms,
> hotkey toggles, single/double click modes, and fixed-position clicking.
> Used by gamers, software testers, and accessibility users since 2015.

## Quick facts
- **Platform**: Windows 7 SP1, 8, 10, 11 (32-bit and 64-bit)
- **File size**: 512 KB
- **Installation**: Portable (no installer required)
- **License**: Open source, free for personal and commercial use
- **Latest version**: 3.0.0 (released November 2024)
- **Default hotkey**: F6 (fully remappable)
- **Maximum click speed**: 100+ CPS in real-world use, 1ms minimum interval
